text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P0 triggered: KV cache continuous-batching traffic spike + speculative-decode drafts diverging. Multiple hosts in us-west-2 hitting cache growth and OOM risk. See: https://pd.redwood/INC-1977777 :rotating_light:

eve_oncall: ack — I'm paged, joining.

alice_w: seeing draft/target sync failures in logs, a lot of invalidated prefixes. tail from runtime logs:```
[2026-03-14T02:06:12Z] WARN kvcache: prefix_miss=4125, invalidations=1023, cache_size_mb=14768
[2026-03-14T02:06:12Z] ERROR speculative: draft_target_mismatch=87%
[2026-03-14T02:06:12Z] INFO batcher: current_batch_size=64, queue_len=4096, token_rate=12000/s
```

ben_ops: customer impact in telemetry: 6 customers (mostly low-SLA) reporting slow streaming responses and partial outputs. Error rate up from 0.3% -> 6.8% in last 10m.

carla_sre: hypothesis: speculative decoding is creating many draft branches that blow out the KV cache when continuous batching groups varied sequence prefixes. Batching config keeps growing KV allocations due to draft churn.

eve_oncall: mitigation plan v1: throttle speculative decoding at runtime (disable speculative paths) + reduce autoscale batch size to protect KV memory. I'll run quick hotfix.

deploy-bot: Deploy request received from eve_oncall: runtime/config/disable_speculative=true, batcher.max_batch=16, kvcache.eviction_policy=aggressive. CI checks skipped by oncall override.

alice_w: before rolling, can we snapshot metrics for rollback? run this:```sh
curl -s "https://metrics.redwood/api/query?m=kvcache.size_mb,kv.invalidations,handler.latency_p95&from=now-15m" > /tmp/inc-1977777-metrics.json
```

ben_ops: doing customer comms draft: "We're investigating an internal inference degradation affecting streaming quality; limited customers impacted; mitigation in progress. Will update in 30m." sending to customer-success-bot to post.

eve_oncall: applying hotfix now on canary (2 nodes in us-west-2):```yaml
- name: runtime-config
  spec:
    disable_speculative: true
    batcher:
      max_batch: 16
    kvcache:
      eviction_policy: LRU_aggressive
```

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: runtime-service/us-west-2 (2/2) updated.

alice_w: canary metrics: p95 latency -> 220ms (from 740ms), kvcache.size_mb per host dropped ~40%, invalidations trending down. Good sign.

carla_sre: rolling to remaining hosts with 10s drift between nodes. Watch for any throughput cliffs. Also enabling a temporary throttle for continuous-batch admission:```cpp
if (batch_queue_len > 2000) { admit_rate *= 0.5; }
```

eve_oncall: rolled to all regions. Observed error rate back down to 0.6% and streaming recovery for impacted customers. Marking initial incident mitigated.

ben_ops: tagging customer-impact list: cust-42, cust-77, cust-21. Outreach queued.

carla_sre: root-cause preliminary: interaction between speculative decoding producing many short-lived drafts + continuous batching merging requests with divergent prefixes causing exponential KV entries until eviction couldn't keep up. Follow-ups: add guardrails on speculative branching, improve KV entry accounting, add per-customer cache caps, and longer-term: smarter batching policy that avoids merging highly divergent prefixes.

eve_oncall: handoff to day SRE @carla_sre for RCA and postmortem. I'll update incident log and close PD alert after postmortem ticket is created.

customer-success-bot: Message queued to affected customers with post-mitigation ETA for full RCA (48h).

eve_oncall: Action items assigned: carla_sre -> RCA + perf regression test; alice_w -> implement metric spike alert for kvcache.invalidations; ben_ops -> customer comms follow-up; eve_oncall -> author quick-runbook for disabling speculative decode safely.

carla_sre: noted. Starting RCA runbook now, will include reproduction script and perf harness. Expect draft PM for postmortem in ~24h. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident INC-1977777 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Handoff complete.
